finding: In the reported toy, averaging all observations performed best when the target was stable, while the 50/50 relay performed better after the target shifted.
limitations: The toy is not evidence of a biological mechanism or general computational speedup.
Named toy source code and CSV were not located with the PDF and are not included.
The reported full-history storage is an implementation choice, not a streaming-average lower bound.
method: Animal-culture literature synthesis and a reported synthetic six-worker noisy-observation comparison in stable and changed environments.
open_questions: Can compact checked inherited state improve work on held-out changed computational tasks after all overhead is counted?
